name: Lame
overview: The Bible reveals God's power to heal and restore those who are lame, demonstrating His compassion and authority through Jesus Christ. In both Isaiah and the Gospels, the lame are depicted as recipients of miraculous healing, symbolizing the transformative work of the Messiah who enables the lame to walk and leap. Jesus' healing of the lame among other afflicted people underscores the arrival of God's kingdom and the fulfillment of His promises to bring wholeness and salvation to the broken.
